feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 14 November 2026 5:00am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 14 November 2026 at 5:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Tending to be fairly cloudy with the risk of a few scattered showers, some of which could be persistent at times, then clearing for the evening. Moderate southwest winds increasing fresh to strong. Maximum temperature of 11°C.

Comments: Strong winds developing.

A band of rain will arrive during the early hours of the morning, remaining persistent and at times heavy through the morning before gradually petering out through the afternoon, leaving some clear intervals and only isolated showers. Fresh to strong, mainly southwest winds will decrease for a time in the morning before veering northwest, then increase again to become strong with a risk of gales by the evening. Maximum temperature 10°C.


##Outlook##

Some clear intervals and a few wintry showers overnight. Minimum temperature of 1°C. Mainly dry with bright or sunny spells during the daytime, then cloud thickens early in the night with a band of rain soon arriving. Moderate to fresh northwest winds becoming light and variable for a time during the day, before becoming easterly in the afternoon, then increasing strong later. Top temperature of 8°C.


##Sunrise##

7:45am Tomorrow


##Sunset##

4:19pm Tomorrow
